experiments.hypothesis: A token index can reduce repeated text-search latency at large library sizes.
experiments.current_workflow: Case-insensitive substring scan over each sample's concatenated metadata.
experiments.proposed_workflow: Normalised token index with ranked candidates before similarity or MAP refinement.
experiments.method: Deterministic synthetic fixtures at 500, 2000, 5000, 10000, and 25000 samples; nine repeats per query.
experiments.metric: Median query time and match-count parity.
experiments.result: At 25000 samples, worst-query median was 241.9812 ms for linear scan and 6.4816 ms for exact-token lookup; one numeric query differed in match count.
experiments.conclusion: Promote as an isolated indexing spike only; preserve fuzzy/substring semantics and prove parity first.

experiments.hypothesis: Viewport culling keeps MAP work bounded by visible points rather than library size.
experiments.current_workflow: Production MAP uses cached static layers and QuadTree viewport queries (observed source evidence); proxy compares full scan with cell culling.
experiments.proposed_workflow: Keep production culling and add measured frame telemetry before changing renderer.
experiments.method: Deterministic point fixtures and a 4% viewport proxy at five point counts.
experiments.metric: Visible-count parity and median hit-test/cull time.
experiments.result: At 25000 points, proxy full scan 11.9241 ms versus cell cull 0.3452 ms with identical visible count.
experiments.conclusion: Do not replace the current MAP architecture based on this proxy; instrument JUCE P95/P99 next.

experiments.hypothesis: Evidence-first provisional proposals can make automation useful without making it authoritative.
experiments.current_workflow: KENN/AutoMix emits measured findings, relationships, previews, and opt-in correction flags in the existing package.
experiments.proposed_workflow: Measure, detect, prioritise, explain with evidence, preview a diff, then require apply/reject and retain undo.
experiments.method: Synthetic noisy, reject, and healthy fixtures through a small state machine.
experiments.result: All invariants passed; the healthy fixture produced no action and all proposals stayed provisional until decision.
experiments.conclusion: Promote the interaction grammar to human testing; do not add chatbot-first presentation.

experiments.hypothesis: The highest-value portable DAW context is transport-aware audition, while richer session control remains host-specific.
experiments.current_workflow: SLO reads BPM, playing state, and PPQ position from the portable host playhead; drag exports original files.
experiments.proposed_workflow: Use portable transport context for audition and an explicitly opt-in Ableton bridge for richer context.
experiments.method: Read-only source audit of SLO JUCE code, KENN Ableton OSC bridge, and product documentation.
experiments.metric: Context classified portable, Ableton-specific, or unavailable/unreliable.
experiments.result: Inventory completed; no live SLO-to-Ableton metadata handoff was found.
experiments.conclusion: Promote transport-aware audition and native drag reliability; park broad automatic project understanding.

experiments.hypothesis: KENN-to-SLO complement search is useful if the boundary carries measured features and references rather than raw audio.
experiments.current_workflow: AI Platform has typed AgentRequest/CapabilityDefinition and company capabilities; candidate audio IDs are not registered live.
experiments.proposed_workflow: Pass issue evidence and sample feature summaries across candidate audio capabilities, preserving product ownership.
experiments.method: Synthetic envelope validation and forbidden private-field checks.
experiments.metric: Accepted safe payloads, rejected raw-audio payloads, ownership invariant.
experiments.result: Both evidence-only directions accepted; raw audio rejected; ownership invariant passed.
experiments.conclusion: Proceed to adapter design review, not production registration.

experiments.hypothesis: A structured first-run journey plus redundant state grammar catches accessibility and localisation failures before UI implementation.
experiments.current_workflow: SLO has editor-level keyboard shortcuts and EMBER supplies redundant semantic encodings; MAP keyboard traversal is absent in the audited source.
experiments.proposed_workflow: Progressive disclosure, explicit empty-state next actions, complete focus model, and adaptive text layout.
experiments.method: Structural control semantics, focus order, reduced-motion, colour-independence, 150% text-scale, and six pseudo-locale width stress.
experiments.metric: Invariant pass rate and overflow detection.
experiments.result: Accessibility invariants passed; nine width overflows were explicitly detected; CJK pseudo had four and 150% scale flagged Reject plus empty-state copy.
experiments.conclusion: Promote keyboard/focus and adaptive layout requirements; require rendered JUCE and screen-reader validation.

experiments.hypothesis: Explicit latency budgets expose the difference between a fast median and an unsafe tail.
experiments.current_workflow: SLO uses cached MAP rendering and message-thread file preparation; platform runtime serves local requests over AF_UNIX.
experiments.proposed_workflow: Release budgets use P95/P99 and worst meaningful spikes, not average FPS or median latency alone.
experiments.method: Synthetic SLO search/MAP proxy plus 100 requests through the existing nite_ai LocalRuntime and temporary SQLite store.
experiments.metric: Median, P95, maximum, frame budget, audio-thread boundary.
experiments.result: IPC median 0.5481 ms, P95 16.3472 ms, max 131.4537 ms; proxy indexed search and culling meet proposed targets.
experiments.conclusion: Adopt budget shape; investigate IPC tails, cold-start, multi-instance, and real JUCE frame traces.

experiments.hypothesis: Thursday is more useful as a concise brief plus approval surface than as an always-chat dashboard.
experiments.current_workflow: Daily brief composes business status, agenda, week ahead, receipts, and scheduler; platform exposes nine company capabilities and separates approval from execution.
experiments.proposed_workflow: Menu-bar/command-palette entry point with prioritised brief, evidence links, and high-risk approval detail.
experiments.method: Read-only architecture audit plus targeted daily-brief tests.
experiments.metric: Capability coverage, approval separation, graceful failure, test outcome.
experiments.result: Approval separation and local runtime pass; daily-brief test file has 2 failures from active-branch handler wiring.
experiments.conclusion: Continue R&D after the active branch integration is repaired; do not broaden into autonomous execution.

experiments.track: PX-H Synthetic User-Journey & Product Friction Lab
experiments.hypothesis: Scenario comparison can rank workflow opportunities before human testing, while exposing complexity regressions.
experiments.current_workflow: Modeled current SLO/KENN/Thursday workflows with multiple context switches and decisions.
experiments.proposed_workflow: Evidence-first common paths with fewer steps, plus explicit parking of chatbot-first UX.
experiments.method: Nine synthetic archetypes by fifteen tasks, with deterministic friction estimates.
experiments.metric: Steps, clicks, keystrokes, contexts, decisions, wait, recovery; current versus proposed.
experiments.result: 135 scenarios generated; complement-search had the largest modeled step reduction; chatbot-first plugin was the only negative step-reduction proposal.
experiments.conclusion: Use the ranked corpus to select moderated human tasks; never report estimates as human usability data.

challenge_reviews.subject: Find Complement
challenge_reviews.challenge: Feature ranking may add a new mode and weakly grounded recommendations.
challenge_reviews.decision: Continue R&D; require candidate acceptance rate, false-positive review, and human time-to-useful-sample evidence.

challenge_reviews.subject: KENN to SLO
challenge_reviews.challenge: Cross-product handoff could duplicate product semantics and leak private audio.
challenge_reviews.decision: Keep only typed features, evidence, and artifact references; no raw audio or production adapter yet.

challenge_reviews.subject: Thursday company interface
challenge_reviews.challenge: A dashboard/chat surface can increase interruption and approval ambiguity.
challenge_reviews.decision: Prefer concise brief plus visual approval detail; continue until active daily-brief tests pass.

challenge_reviews.subject: MAP interaction
challenge_reviews.challenge: New renderer or map modes could destabilise an already-cached implementation.
challenge_reviews.decision: Instrument production-shaped JUCE traces before redesign; preserve the current architecture.
